intro_summary: 本章用較少位元保存權重的空間節省作起點，接著討論離散刻度、誤差、分組和位元打包，延伸到實际運算、PTQ、校準與QAT。數值相近和生成行為一致是不同驗證問題；權重量化是較小的起步範圍，中間特徵及QAT依需求選用。空間縮小與後端加速需要分開測量。

sources.title: Actual original-fence and bounded CPU storage verification
Independent arithmetic for dense tensor payload and full model partition
sources.details: 64*32=2048. FP32/FP16/int8 payloads are 2048*(4,2,1)=(8192,4096,2048) bytes; 128*32=4096 doubles totals. Linear weights=2*(4*64*64+256*64+64*256)+264*64=115200. Biases=2*(256+64)=640. Other FP32=264*64+128*64+(2*2+1)*2*64=25728. Logical original parameters=115200+640+25728=141568. Per-output-row scales=2*(4*64+256+64)+264=1416. Retained FP32 incl. bias=26368, storage=105472 bytes. Scales=5664 bytes. Original payload=460800+105472=566272. 4-bit payload=57600+105472+5664=168736. 8-bit payload=115200+105472+5664=226336. File excesses are 588358-566272=22086, 182277-168736=13541 and 242085-226336=15749. All matrix counts refer to this exact untied 264-vocab, 64-width, 2-layer config, not arbitrary full-model INT4/INT8 ratios.

claims.scope: Standard datatype widths and lower-precision representation; no accuracy preservation or hardware speedup is claimed by the zero-table exercise.
